post.line: The sorting pile is still on the counter. Come in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

condo.line: The arcade floor and machines are waiting. Come in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

store.line: The shelves need restocking. Come in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

cafe.line: The counter has been quiet without you. Come in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

stand.line: The stand is short of staff. Please come in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

post.line: Two weeks with no sorting, so the job is gone. Ask again and you start from the first rank. Noted.

condo.line: Two weeks with no work done, so the arcade job is gone. Ask again and you start from the first rank.

store.line: Two weeks with nothing done, so the store job is gone. Ask again and you start from the first rank.

cafe.line: Two weeks without a cup, so the job is gone. Ask again and you start from the first rank.

stand.line: Review complete: two weeks without a glass, so the job is gone. Ask again and you start from the first rank.

cafe.line: Come to the Coffee Cup when you can. I have news, and your last cup already knew it.

stand.line: Please report to the lemonade stand. Management has news regarding your position.

condo.line: Come and see me at the arcade! I have news, and the cabinets are sworn to secrecy.

store.line: Come by the store when the bell is quiet. I have news that will not keep on a shelf.

post.line: Come by the post office when you can. I have news, and it has been weighed.

wage.line: Your pay is here: {n} coins for the work you finished. I filed it myself.
wage.none: No work was done last week, so there is no pay this time.

review.full: A full week: {xp} work XP extra.
review.poor: A poor week: {xp} work XP taken back.

wage.warned: Your boss wants a word about it.
wage.demoted: You were moved down a rank.

welcome.line: I have entered {home} in the big book. The plot is yours at last. I am glad to close that folder.

movedin.line: I swept past {home} and saw the tent up. It looks lived in now, which is the point of a tent.

firstbeast.line: I heard there is an animal at {home}. Good. A plot with an animal has started making sense.

shed.line: I hear your shed is filling up. Good. Now take things out and place them around your yard.

week.line: The big book says {home} has been yours for one week now. Happy first week.
